subject: Re: Rapid Integration Hack Day — partner series & demo plan
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@integrify.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: marketing@integrify.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Rapid Integration Hack Day — partnership idea and draft proposal

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — excited about a potential collab. Integrify runs a quarterly developer-facing "Rapid Integration" hack day (virtual + one regional in-person) that pairs ISVs with platform partners to co-build tiny end-to-end demos in 90 minutes. Our audience is field engineers and developer advocates at mid-market companies — typically ~200 registered, with a 40% live attendance rate.

Attached is a short proposal (integrify-proposal-v2.pdf) that covers format, promo cadence, and a suggested speaker list (we can swap people). High-level asks from our side:
- Co-host (Redwood) to provide a 15–20 min demo template and a sandbox environment for attendees.
- Two Redwood engineers (one product, one field eng) as speakers/panelists.
- Co-branded landing page and shared registrant list (GDPR-compliant).

Tentative dates: week of Jan 24 or Feb 7 — open to whichever aligns with Redwood's availability.

Would love to set a 30-min planning call this week to lock scope and marketing commitments.

Best,
Sarah Patel
Head of Partnerships, Integrify
Integrify — "Make integrations happen"

Attachment: integrify-proposal-v2.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@integrify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid Integration Hack Day — partnership idea and draft proposal

Sarah — really appreciate the deck and the clear asks. This is squarely in our partner events playbook and it's the kind of developer-focused format we like.

Quick responses:
- We can commit a product engineer + field eng for the 20-min demo slot. Jonas will lead the demo content; I'll coordinate the product narrative.
- Co-branded landing page: we need to confirm legal/marketing requirements (Marissa, see below).
- Registrant list: we can share hashed emails / segments to avoid PII transfer; our legal will propose a simple addendum to the MSA.

Marissa / Jonas — can you both weigh in on marketing windows and minimum promo lead time? Integrify proposes Jan 24 / Feb 7 — if we pick Jan 24 we need a launch by Dec 6 to hit a 7-week cadence.

A few operational notes for the planning call:
- Sandbox: do you have a short-run API key or ephemeral sandbox that attendees can use? If not we can prepare a lightweight Docker image with a no-cost model for the workshop.
- Demo template: we should scope a single "integration pattern" (e.g., webhook-triggered inference + prefix caching) that attendees can reproduce in 90 minutes.

I can do a 30-min sync Wed or Thu morning. Which works for you?

Thanks — excited to move fast on this.

—Karthik
Director, Alliances & Field Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah@integrify.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid Integration Hack Day — partnership idea and draft proposal

Thanks Sarah — this looks promising. A few notes from demand gen / comms:

Promo & creative timing:
- Preferred launch cadence: 6–8 weeks (email + 3 social pushes + one partner webinar). If we aim for Jan 24, launch target is Dec 6 (Karthik's calc is right).
- Co-branded landing page: we typically request 3 business days for initial build + 2 days for review. Please share Integrify's logo in SVG and your brand guidelines.
- Paid social: recommend a small $5k spend split 50/50 for 2 weeks pre-event to hit dev audiences.

Assets & legal:
- We'll need a one-page marketing addendum and a short DP/registrant handling note for legal. Please review the DocuSign link below when you have a minute.

Speakers & content:
- We'll prep a demo scaffold and a downloadable repo for attendees. Jonas — can you draft the scaffold by Fri (Nov 20)?

I've uploaded a promo/ops workbook (hackday-promo-plan.xlsx) to the shared Drive.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Growth Marketing
Redwood Inference

Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDef-GhI_RapidHackday

From: Sarah Patel <sarah@integrify.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Tomas Rojas <tomas@devopscollective.com>, marketing@integrify.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid Integration Hack Day — partnership idea and draft proposal

Great — thanks for the fast turnaround. Quick answers / confirmations:
- Jan 24 works for Integrify (we'll lock venue availability and the virtual platform this afternoon).
- We will send SVG logos and brand guidelines by EOD today.
- Agree to hashed/email-segment sharing; we'll sign the short MSA addendum in DocuSign today.
- Speaker list: Sarah (Integrify Partnerships), Tomas Rojas (DevRel, DevOps Collective) and we confirm two Redwood speakers (Karthik/field eng + Jonas).

Attached is the final agenda (rapid-hackday-final-agenda.pdf) — the demo block is 90 mins and we added a 20-min lightning Q&A.

A couple of asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a 10-seat sandbox for live debugging during the session (temp credentials OK)?
2) We'd like Redwood to prepare a one-page "cookbook" post-event that lists the integration steps + code snippets for registrants.

If both are OK we'll mark the project "confirmed" and proceed to marketing launch.

Best,
Sarah

Attachment: rapid-hackday-final-agenda.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

Owners / next steps:
- Jonas Weber: demo scaffold + downloadable repo (due Nov 22).
- Marissa Cole: landing page build + paid social plan (launch Dec 6).
- Monica Patel (CS): prepare 10-seat sandbox + access tokens (temp creds) and test by Dec 15.
- Karthik Iyer: coordinate speaker brief, finalize co-brand copy, collect logos and publish the registrant sharing note.

Deliverables to Integrify by Nov 24: demo scaffold, sandbox test confirmation, and co-brand creative brief.

I'll set a 30-min planning call for next Tue (Nov 23) — invite to follow.

Thanks — let's move quickly and keep communication tight in this thread.

—Karthik
